BACKGROUND | BACKGROUND
Pipeline failures become costly because defects travel before users see them. | Pipeline failures become costly because defects travel before users see them.

Modern ETL pipelines combine structured and semi-structured sources, changing schemas, scheduled transformations, cloud storage, and downstream analytics dependencies. A small defect can move from ingestion to reporting before it becomes visible. | Modern ETL pipelines combine structured and semi-structured sources, changing schemas, scheduled transformations, cloud storage, and downstream analytics dependencies. A small defect can move from ingestion to reporting before it becomes visible.
Batch jobs often run unattended or outside normal working hours. | Batch jobs often run unattended or outside normal working hours.
Traditional monitoring is usually reactive after failure messages appear. | Traditional monitoring is usually reactive after failure messages appear.
Machine learning can support early warning, not replace engineering judgement. | Machine learning can support early warning, not replace engineering judgement.

Aim | Aim

To design and develop a log analysis and failure prediction system for ETL batch jobs using XGBoost. | To design and develop a log analysis and failure prediction system for ETL batch jobs using XGBoost.
Identify and characterize common failure patterns in data pipeline batch jobs. | Identify and characterize common failure patterns in data pipeline batch jobs.
Compare multiple machine learning algorithms using accuracy-oriented metrics. | Compare multiple machine learning algorithms using accuracy-oriented metrics.
Develop a prediction model that continuously monitors batch pipeline execution. | Develop a prediction model that continuously monitors batch pipeline execution.
Test and evaluate using Precision, Recall, F1-score, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, and confusion-matrix counts. | Test and evaluate using Precision, Recall, F1-score, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, and confusion-matrix counts.
